summary: CNH Industrial Capital LLC filed an 8-K to report the pricing of $600 million aggregate principal amount of its 4.950% notes due 2031, issued under an existing shelf registration statement. The notes mature June 25, 2031, with semi-annual interest payments starting December 25, 2026. Proceeds will be used for working capital, general corporate purposes, including receivables purchases, or to repay indebtedness. The notes are guaranteed by two wholly owned subsidiaries. This is a routine debt offering, not a special-situation event. No merger, acquisition, restructuring, or strategic change is involved.
